label: PanTHERIA 1.0 (WR05 taxonomy, August 2008): species-level life history, ecology and geography of extant and recently extinct mammals
governance: Ecological Society of America data paper (Jones et al. 2009, Ecology 90:2648, Ecological Archives E090-184; DOI 10.1890/08-1494.1 resolves, checked 2026-10-31). Peer reviewed as a data paper; no ongoing curation after publication. The ESA archive files state no licence; the ESA/Wiley figshare mirror of the same archive (article 3531875, 'Full Archive', ECOL_90_184.zip, published 2016-08-05) is labelled CC0.
versioning: Single frozen release, version 1.0 in two taxonomies (WR05 = Wilson & Reeder 2005, and WR93). File name PanTHERIA_1-0_WR05_Aug2008.txt; 5,416 species rows, 55 columns (re-derived 2026-10-31). No later versions exist.
known_issues: The Ecological Archives directory https://esapubs.org/archive/ecol/E090/184/ answers HTTP 403 to non-browser clients, so records using it as identifier do not resolve by script even though the data file itself downloads (HTTP 200) and its SHA-256 matches.

No licence statement in the distributed file; vendored records variously say 'none', 'free for non-commercial use with citation' or 'CC0 (figshare mirror)'. The CC0 label is a property of the Wiley figshare deposit, not of esapubs.
Taxonomy is MSW3/WR05 (2005): species renamed since then (Neogale vison, formerly Neovison vison/Mustela vison) are not found by their current binomial.
rationale: A peer-reviewed data paper with a registered DOI, a stable frozen file and documented column semantics give high authority; the only deductions are the missing licence statement and the archive directory now being blocked. PanTHERIA is a literature compilation (secondary data), and it is in turn ingested by EltonTraits for mammal body mass, so independence is moderate. Every DOI and file checked traces to the real source and the row count (5,416) was reproduced exactly from the downloaded file.
